title: Change to electronics returns
text: From **1 August 2026**, the return window for electronics and accessories is 7 days. Electronics **delivered before 1 August 2026** keep the earlier 10-day window from version 3 of this policy.

title: Can I return something I bought?
text: Most items can be returned within the return window. Some items, like grocery, cannot be returned.

title: Returns and refunds
text: Return windows, reverse pickup and refunds are the same for every seller and are handled by ZentroMart.

title: Return windows by category
text: The return window starts on the **delivery date** and is counted in calendar days. The category of every product is listed in the `return_category` column of the product catalog. | Category | Return window | Catalog code | | --- | --- | --- | | Electronics and accessories | 7 days | `electronics` | | Clothing, footwear and bags | 15 days | `fashion` | | Home, kitchen and furniture | 10 days | `home_kitchen` | | Beauty and personal care (unopened, seal intact) | 7 days | `beauty_sealed` | | Books and stationery | 10 days | `books_media` | | Grocery, fresh and perishables | Not returnable | `grocery` | | Innerwear, lingerie and swimwear | Not returnable | `innerwear` | | Gift cards and digital codes | Not returnable | `digital` |

title: Booking
text: Raise the return from My Orders. Choose a pickup slot. The delivery executive will check the item at the door against the condition rules in RET-4.
